title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person leg's taken-over stand-down is read-time only — the executed awaiting UPDATE still lacks the taken_over_at backstop (TOCTOU)
evidence:
form_handler.gleam:
              case
                sql.update_reference_call_status(
                  config.db,
                  id_uuid,
                  sql.AwaitingCorrection,
                  "",
                  "contact_invalid",
                  sql.ContactInitiated,
                )
update_reference_call_status.sql:
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = $5::reference_call_status

(grep: mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person referenced only by sql.gleam:1891 and test lines 1746/1758 — the handler never calls it)
detail: The guarded mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql is orphaned; apply_wrong_person still executes the status-only-guarded update, and take-over never changes status, so a take-over between lookup and UPDATE still yanks the row into awaiting_correction.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's awaiting arm; replace the direct-SQL pin with a test driving the real /reference/<token>/wrong-person POST with a take-over between read and UPDATE.

evidence:
Line 73:   `take_over_reference_call.sql`, `correct_reference_call.sql` (guard + corrected_* +
   cycle bump + re-arm in ONE update), `substitute_reference_call.sql` (reads the old row's
   slot/owner + verifies the pre-state guard)
Line 233:   effective name. One additive column, nothing destructive.
detail: No substitute_reference_call.sql exists (implementation uses insert_reference_call_if_absent.sql + find_live_row_for_slot); the migration ships corrected_name AND corrected_at, not one column. epic-RC4-context.md was fixed; these two spots were not.
recommended_fix: Update the artifact: substitute uses insert_reference_call_if_absent.sql; state the migration adds corrected_name and corrected_at (expand-only).

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): Escape-to-close keydown handler is still on the unfocusable menu div — the natural click-then-Escape flow does nothing
evidence:
html.div(
          [
            attribute("data-testid", "refcheck-menu-" <> slot),
            attribute("role", "menu"),
            // r2 (N14): Escape closes the menu (the confirm_modal pattern).
            event.on(
              "keydown",
              menu_escape_decoder(msg.UserToggledRefcheckMenu(
                call.reference_call_id,
              )),
            ),
detail: The handler remains on the menu div, a sibling of the focused ⋯ button; no autofocus or effect moves focus into the menu, so pressing Escape after clicking ⋯ never reaches the listener.
recommended_fix: Move the keydown listener onto the ⋯ button, or autofocus the first menu item when the menu opens, so click-then-Escape closes it.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): opening a second row's correct/substitute edit still discards another row's in-progress typed trio
evidence:
RefcheckSubstitute -> #(
          Model(
            ..menu_closed,
            refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(
              model,
              call_id,
              RefcheckEditSubstitute,
            )),
          ),
          effect.none(),
        )
        RefcheckCorrect -> #(
          Model(
            ..menu_closed,
            refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit(
              model,
              call_id,
              RefcheckEditCorrect,
            )),
          ),
detail: The success-clear is now call-scoped (edit_kept, fixed), but UserChoseRefcheckAction still overwrites refcheck_edit unconditionally — a menu/button choice on row B drops row A's unsaved typed trio with no guard.
recommended_fix: Guard the overwrite: if refcheck_edit holds unsaved values for a different call_id, keep them (or require cancel) instead of replacing with a fresh prefill.
